name: rack-pec-stretch
instructions:
1. In an upright position, setup in a squat rack with your elbow at 90 degrees and your feet in a split stance.
2. Ensure the elbow is at (or slightly higher) than shoulder height and place your free hand on your ribcage to monitor spinal positioning.
3. Slowly lean forward and increase the stretch on your pec.
4. Hold for time, breaths, or repetitions and repeat on the opposite arm.
